text:
harini: Heads-up — we need a safer, auditable flow for temporary unmasking of request/response for canary debugging. The current ad-hoc SSH-to-logs + local decrypt is a no-go for audits.

alex: +1. Constraints: tenant quotas, PII risk, and an immutable audit trail. My initial thought: per-route redact profiles + timeboxed inspect sessions that require justification/approval.

matt: Can we reuse the inspect-gatekeeper service? Also — how do attachments and embeddings factor in? They’re higher risk.

harini: Reuse gatekeeper where possible. Treat attachments/embeddings as "always redacted" by default; inspect sessions can optionally allow a tokenized/blurred view only. Session TTL = 15m, auto-scrub on expiry.

anya: UX idea: console "Request Inspect" button -> short justification text -> choose approver/team -> request ticket/email goes to oncall. Approver can grant a session that shows a masked/unmasked view toggle.

luke: Add KMS/HSM access audit: every unmask operation must log the key_id used and an unwrap call. Legal/security should get an audit export option.

sre-bot: deploy queued: feat/inspect-session-proto -> canary to internal clusters next week :rocket: 

alex: Example of the route-level config I’m thinking of:
```
route: /v1/generate
redact_profile: strict_v2
inspect_policy:
  ttl_seconds: 900
  approver_role: oncall
  justification_required: true
  audit_log: enabled
  temp_quota_bump: disabled
```

matt: How does sampling interact? We can't escalate sampling for a tenant without tripping QoS. If an engineer requests a full inspect of a high-volume route, that could blow through quotas.

harini: Plan: allow a tied temporary quota bump for an inspect session. Bump rules: small fixed headroom (e.g., +5% tokens or +5k tokens, whichever is smaller) and tied to the session ID. All usage during the session is accounted to a special telemetry counter and bill bucket.

anya: Also require a mandatory debrief/notes field in the UI — the session auto-closes after TTL and if the debrief is missing it flags for review.

alex: Telemetry hooks we need: inspect_sessions_started, inspect_sessions_approved, inspect_sessions_denied, bytes_unredacted, key_unwrap_calls, temp_quota_bumps_granted. Add tags: route, tenant, approver_role.

luke: Add a forensic export gate: exports that contain unredacted data require dual approval (security + legal) and a one-time HSM-wrapped export token.

harini: Rollout proposal: 1) backend: session object + audit events 2) minimal console button + request flow 3) internal-only canary (core infra/org) 4) expand to platform teams. Monitor telemetry above + unauthorized unmask attempts. Rollback threshold: >0.5% of sessions with policy violations or any key_access anomaly.

sre-bot: note: created ticket INF-1234 for implementation, owners: @harini, @alex, @anya

harini: I'll draft a short RFC that includes config schema, telemetry counters, and the minimal console wireframe. Want volunteers to co-author and review before I post to the privacy channel.

anya: I’ll co-author the UI and approval flow. :+1:

alex: I’ll own telemetry hooks and the quota bump logic.

luke: I can take the KMS/HSM audit + export gating bits.

harini: Great — thanks. Leaving this thread as the decision record for the initial design. If you want to be added to the RFC reviewers ping me or reply here.
